definition: The connected events of a story.
example: The plot follows a musician who discovers an unfinished melody.

definition: The place and time of a story.
example: The film is set in a small railway station in the present day.

definition: A person in the story.
example: Mara is the main character; she plays the guitar.

definition: The group of actors in a film.
example: The cast includes both new and experienced actors.

definition: The way an actor plays a role.
example: The lead actor gives a convincing performance.

definition: One part of a film, usually in one place or period of time.
example: My favorite scene takes place on the platform.

definition: The final part of the story.
example: Please do not reveal the ending.

definition: The music used in a film.
example: The soundtrack connects the scenes through one melody.

definition: An individual performer.
example: The artist sings her own songs.

definition: A group that performs music.
example: The band includes a drummer and a guitarist.

definition: One recorded piece of music.
example: My favorite track is the first song.

definition: A collection of recorded pieces.
example: Their new album contains ten tracks.

definition: The words of a song.
example: The lyrics tell a story about friendship.

definition: A repeated section of a song.
example: Everyone sings along with the chorus.

definition: The regular pulse of music.
example: The drummer keeps a steady beat.

definition: A sequence of notes recognized as a tune.
example: She plays the melody on the piano.

definition: A visual production made to accompany a song.
example: The music video shows the band on a train.

definition: Recorded plays of a video.
example: The video has a thousand views.

definition: A ranked list of songs or albums.
example: The song is at the top of the chart.

definition: A successful or popular song.
example: Their latest song is a hit.

definition: A film that aims to make you laugh.
example: A group of friends keeps making the same silly mistake.

definition: A story about relationships, emotions or difficult choices.
example: A musician must choose between a job and her dream.

definition: A tense story that keeps you wondering what will happen.
example: A detective follows a stranger who knows her secret.

definition: A film that aims to frighten the audience.
example: Someone hears footsteps in an empty house.

definition: A story driven by physical challenges and fast events.
example: An explorer escapes through a crowded city.

definition: A story that imagines science, technology or other worlds.
example: An astronaut discovers a signal from another planet.

definition: A way of making films with drawn or digitally created moving images.
example: An animated adventure can also be a comedy or a drama.

definition: A film that explores real people, events or subjects.
example: A filmmaker follows wildlife in its natural environment.
